## Summary

Translation: "I have 17 discretionary-derived edges whose advantage I've already confirmed — I've decided to incorporate all of them index-style and run them together. Designed so that if one edge breaks, the others compensate. My past self-built EAs have run publicly on myfxbook for over a year without blowing up — but in the end, forward performance is everything. This one too: first go collect forward data."

The chart shows the per-instrument members of the index: panels around PF 1.9–2.0, Sharpe 2.1–3.1 (e.g. XAU: PF 1.94, Sharpe 2.09, NXDD 7.1; another PF 2.04, Sharpe 3.06), 2020–2026 windows with HDD/NXDD-style risk columns (OCR cells approximate — one panel reads "PF .89", likely a mangled 1.89; don't quote without the full-res check).

## Why it matters

- Same architecture thesis as the MarginCall4 breakout family in our vault: many mediocre-correlated edges, combined into one book so single-edge decay doesn't kill the machine — cf. [[2026-10-27-margincall4-l-s-breakout-portfolio-addition]] (combined Sharpe above every sleeve) and [[2026-10-31-margincall4-bob-l-s-qqq-low-corr]] (correlation budgeting across strategies, 0.44 between siblings).
- The humility line is the capture reason: "in the end, forward is everything" from someone with 1+ year of public, unbroken myfxbook track record — he still refuses to sell the backtest. This is the lived version of the rule our validation captures keep converging on ([[2026-10-28-margincall4-overfitting-validation-dsr-pbo-walkforward]]): the honest number is out-of-sample.
- **Skepticism gates:** 17 edges each "confirmed" is a multiple-testing pile — each edge cleared some in-sample bar before being admitted, and combining them doesn't launder that selection. Same-day caution from [[2026-10-31-dmartin-calibrating-robustness-checks]]: stacking more checks on top of each other added nothing and can hurt. Self-reported grid, discretionary-FX context (different market microstructure than our futures/ETF queue), OCR cells approximate, machine translation.
- Reference only — no vault task. The idea (edge-index + correlation budget + forward-first) is already represented in the TF-queue replication standards.
